title: Express #6462: logError loses Error.cause and async stack traces

error_signal.message: express Error: logerror in application.js loses Error.cause, async stack traces, and custom properties when logging with err.stack or err.toString()

ground_truth.root_cause_description: logerror uses console.error(err.stack || err.toString()) which strips Error.cause, async stack traces, and custom error properties like Sequelize's parent/original.
ground_truth.fix_description: Change to console.error(err) to preserve all error details
